name: Poison and proliferate
description: Win with poison counters instead of damage. Black, green and blue cards with toxic and infect, proliferate to add more counters, ways past blockers and a few strong finishers.

cards.name: Ruuskara, the Seeping Bloom
cards.rule_text:
Deathtouch, toxic 1
Whenever one or more creatures you control deal combat damage to a player, proliferate.
cards.flavor_text: Where she walks, the flowers glisten and the soil goes quiet.

cards.name: Thessyl, Grafter of the Glass Vats
cards.rule_text:
At the beginning of your end step, proliferate.
Whenever you proliferate, draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.

cards.name: Bilewing Gnat
cards.rule_text:
Flying, toxic 1
When CARDNAME dies, proliferate.

cards.name: Seepwater Infiltrator
cards.rule_text:
Toxic 1
CARDNAME can't be blocked.
cards.flavor_text: You never see it come in. You only find the oil on the floor.

cards.name: Blightroot Tender
cards.rule_text:
{T}: Add {G}.
{4}, {T}: Proliferate.

cards.name: Oilglass Skimmer
cards.rule_text:
Flying, toxic 1
When CARDNAME enters, proliferate.

cards.name: Vat-Grown Strangler
cards.rule_text: Trample, infect
cards.flavor_text: It was grown for one purpose, and it has never once been distracted.

cards.name: Brood-Mother of the Mire
cards.rule_text:
Toxic 1
Whenever an opponent gets one or more poison counters, create a 1/1 colorless Phyrexian Mite artifact creature token with toxic 1 and "This creature can't block." This ability triggers only once each turn.

cards.name: Ruinscale Despoiler
cards.rule_text:
Menace, toxic 2
Corrupted — When CARDNAME enters, each opponent who has three or more poison counters sacrifices a creature.

cards.name: Blightbloom Wurm
cards.rule_text:
Trample, toxic 3
When CARDNAME enters, proliferate, then proliferate again.

cards.name: Sudden Spore-Bloom
cards.rule_text: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature, then proliferate.

cards.name: Insight from the Lattice
cards.rule_text: Scry 2, then draw a card. Proliferate.

cards.name: Weeping Oil Wound
cards.rule_text: Put two -1/-1 counters on target creature, then proliferate.

cards.name: Drown in Black Oil
cards.rule_text: Counter target spell, then proliferate.

cards.name: Slip Through the Seams
cards.rule_text: Creatures you control with toxic or infect can't be blocked this turn.
cards.flavor_text: Every wall has a crack. Every crack is a door.

cards.name: Choking Spore-Cloud
cards.rule_text: Put a -1/-1 counter on each creature, then proliferate.

cards.name: Whispers in the Vats
cards.rule_text: Corrupted — At the beginning of your upkeep, scry 1. Then if an opponent has three or more poison counters, draw a card.

cards.name: Oil-Tipped Lance
cards.rule_text:
Equipped creature gets +1/+0 and has toxic 2.
Equip {2}

cards.name: Vashka, Voice of the Seep
cards.rule_text:
+1: Proliferate.
−2: Create two 1/1 colorless Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens with toxic 1 and "This creature can't block."
−7: Each opponent gets a poison counter for each creature you control.

cards.name: Seeping Undercroft
cards.rule_text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{3}, {T}: Proliferate. Activate only as a sorcery.
